_grade: [L] LOCKED external input. Ordinal first-appearance/peak Carnegie stages (CS) of the crisp CARDIAC developmental MILESTONES of the human heart, compiled from standard human-embryology references. NEVER adjusted to change a correlation. heart_substages.py treats this table as read-only and tests corr(DNA-derived sub-stage schedule, observed stage); the table does not depend on gamma in any way.
_provenance: Ordinal cardiac-milestone Carnegie stages compiled from standard references: O'Rahilly R & Muller F, 'Developmental Stages in Human Embryos' (Carnegie Inst. of Washington, Publ. 637, 1987; 2nd ed. 2010); Moorman AFM & Christoffels VM, 'Cardiac chamber formation' (Physiol Rev 2003); Sadler TW, 'Langman's Medical Embryology'; Larsen's Human Embryology (Schoenwolf et al.). Canonical, textbook-stable ORDINAL stages. Exact day estimates are contextual only and are NOT used in the rank-correlation test.
_method: Each cardiac milestone below is tagged with ONE canonical specifier master gene, and the model's sub-stage schedule for the heart is argsort(spinodal(gamma)) -- a pure readout of MEASURED gamma (heart_gamma.json, fetched by the IDENTICAL NCBI->SantaLucia pipeline used for organ_gamma.json). The test reports Spearman rho and Pearson r between the gamma-derived schedule and the observed CS, plus an exact permutation p-value (n=8 -> n!=40320, exact + deterministic). RANK correlation is used so the result is robust to +/-1-stage encoding uncertainty; heart_substages.py additionally reports a +/-1 CS jitter robustness band.
_forced_choice_note: [F] ONE-SPECIFIER-PER-MILESTONE. Cardiac transcription factors are pleiotropic and act combinatorially across multiple stages (e.g. NKX2-5, GATA4 and TBX5 each function from specification through septation). Assigning a SINGLE canonical specifier to each milestone is therefore a documented forced modelling choice, taken so that each gene represents its single most characteristic role: NKX2-5=cardiac specification, GATA4=tube fusion (cardia bifida if lost), HAND2=looping/RV, ISL1=second heart field/OFT, TBX5=chamber identity (Holt-Oram), SOX9=endocardial-cushion/valve EMT, MEF2C=ventricular myocardial differentiation, TBX1=outflow-tract (conotruncal) septation (DiGeorge). This pleiotropy is recorded, not hidden; it is one reason the single-organ test, like the 8-organ test, is power-limited.
_frozen: This table is content-frozen; verify_heart_substages.py check #2 pins its sha256 and asserts the stages are integers independent of the gamma table (not back-fitted).

heart_tube_fusion.event: paired endocardial tubes fuse to a single heart tube; first contraction
heart_tube_fusion.ref: O'Rahilly&Muller: heart tube CS10; GATA4-null -> cardia bifida

cardiac_looping.event: dextral (d-) looping of the heart tube; right-ventricle formation
cardiac_looping.ref: Moorman&Christoffels: looping CS10-11; HAND2 essential for loop/RV

second_heart_field.event: second-heart-field cells added at the poles; outflow-tract elongation
second_heart_field.ref: ISL1 SHF master; OFT elongation CS11-12

chamber_formation.event: chamber ballooning; primitive atrium/ventricle identity; AV canal
chamber_formation.ref: Moorman&Christoffels: chamber formation CS12-13; TBX5 chamber identity

endocardial_cushion.event: AV + outflow endocardial cushions; EMT; valve primordia
endocardial_cushion.ref: Sadler/Larsen: endocardial cushions CS14; SOX9 cushion mesenchyme

ventricular_septation.event: muscular interventricular septum; trabeculation; ventricular myocardial maturation
ventricular_septation.ref: Larsen: muscular IVS CS15-16; MEF2C ventricular/OFT myocardium

outflow_tract_septation.ref: Sadler: OFT septation CS16-17; TBX1 (22q11) conotruncal
